summary: Clearwater County lookout site: a 1919 cabin, replaced by a hip-roofed L-4 cab in 1934, now abandoned and listed as gone with no source describing the site today.

facts.design: Hip-roofed L-4 cab (1934) on a rock base about 14 by 14 feet, replacing a 1919 cabin
facts.status_note: Abandoned, and a regional list marks it gone. No source gives the year it was abandoned or lost, and none describes the site today.

staffing.status: Two named staff members, Bob Elliott and Turk Oliver, in 1925, per Idaho Fire Lookouts

access.note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags it Hike-In. We found no closure notice and no route description.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags it Hike-In. firelookout.com places it seven miles west of Kelly Creek R.S.

events.note: A telephone line was to be extended toward Pot Mountain, which a newspaper called possibly one of the very best lookout points in the Clearwater country
First lookout: a 12-by-12-foot cabin of whipsawed lumber with a map board on the roof
Bob Elliott and Turk Oliver listed as known staff. The register does not date the foundation work they did in one summer.
Hip-roofed L-4 cab built about 500 feet south of the 1919 cabin, on a rock base
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on May 22, 2022, nominated by Rod Fosback

evidence.supports: administered by Clearwater National Forest, U.S. Forest Service

evidence.supports: rock base for the new lookout, 14 by 14 foot

evidence.quote: Lookouts Bob Elliott and Turk Oliver used their spare time one summer to construct the rock foundation for the new lookout.

evidence.supports: base blasted and winched by hand, 14 foot square
evidence.quote: blasted and winched enough rock for the new lookout's 14 foot by 14 foot base

corrections.proposed: 1919 first lookout built; 1934 hip-roofed L-4 cab replaced it
corrections.why: The register's description says the first lookout was built in 1919 and replaced in 1934. The record's 1934 comes only from the register's Built field.

notes_for_editor: No source describes what remains at the Pot Mountain site, and none dates the abandonment. The FFLOS register says two lookouts built the rock base one summer, undated; Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the same two men as staff in 1925. We do not link the two. The 1914 item is a newspaper excerpt transcribed on a fan site. The brief's 1934 build date is corrected above. No photo with a usable URL was found.
